fact: Ghana's Communication minister Samuel Nartey George said the government's forthcoming Innovation and Startup legislative framework will set eligibility criteria for startups and give a legal foundation to a planned national fintech fund.
source_slug: 2026-07-07 Ghana and UNDP Strengthen Partnership on Digital Transformation Projects

fact: The Labari Journal lists the Ghana Innovation and Startup Bill among 15 ICT-related bills to be laid before or being considered by Ghana's Parliament, with no confirmation they will pass.

Ghana's communications and digital ministry says the Draft Innovation and Start-Up Bill, covering tax relief, funding access and a certified startup label, is in nationwide validation workshops as of 25 September 2025.
Ecosystem actors presented a workplan and a drafting roadmap for the Ghana Innovation and Startup Bill to the Communications Minister, per the Ministry.
